description: Full dossier for ONE Amazon product, by ASIN or by retail barcode (UPC / EAN / GTIN / ISBN-13): current price, buy-box seller and condition, every current seller (price, FBA/FBM/Amazon, delivery), stock state, BSR and category, rating and review count, Amazon's bought-past-month badge, dimensions and weight, plus observed history - price changes, stock changes, sub-daily buy-box points for frequently refreshed products, rating history. Set include_history=true for the long series (per-seller offer history and the daily buy-box price back to 2023 on Amazon US, BSR history). Use when the user has a specific product and asks 'what does this sell for now', 'who is on this listing', 'has the price moved', 'is it in stock', 'analyse this ASIN', or gives a barcode from a supplier list. Answers from stored observations in milliseconds; refresh=true reads the live Amazon page (10-30 seconds). Amazon marketplaces only.

asin.description: 10-character Amazon ASIN. Provide asin or barcode.

barcode.description: UPC-12 / EAN-13 / GTIN-14 / ISBN-13 instead of an ASIN. Resolved through observed listings, then Amazon's own search.

include_content.description: Attach the listing content: description, bullets, featured reviews.

include_history.description: Attach the long history series (offer history per seller, daily buy-box price, BSR history).

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR. Amazon only.

refresh.description: Read the live Amazon page now instead of the stored snapshot.

name: product_dossier
